images.caption: PolyMesh pipeline: STEP/B-rep CAD through feature analysis and a gradient-limited sizing field into the hybrid meshers, unified FE+VEM assembly, solve, ZZ error estimate and the hp-adapt decision that feeds back into the sizing field.

Feature-graded vs PolyMesh's own frozen uniform tet10 baseline on the D6 L-domain: 6,384 -> 1,248 DOF and 2.762 s -> 0.227 s at the same energy deficit band. Internal self-comparison, not a comparison against any external solver.

Method-of-manufactured-solutions energy-norm convergence: frozen P1 elements at 0.997/0.997/2.000/2.000 against theory 1/1/2/2, and the hierarchical p-basis at 1.02/1.99/2.98/3.98 against theory 1/2/3/4.
Tier-1 analytical verification: every case inside tolerance, measured on structured parametric verification meshes rather than product Cartesian grid-fill meshes.

Close-up on the hole (identical camera in both panels, 40 mm window): uniform (--no-feature, h = 3.8 mm) vs feature-graded (h = 5.6 mm) sizing on the same part and mesher, h tuned to a matched element budget: 43,360 vs 40,557 cells (6.5% apart), 26,994 vs 26,766 DOF.
